== Objectives ==
Seek out [[Livia Strongarm]] at [[Blackthorn's Camp]] in [[Gilneas]].

==Description==
Livia has been part of this outfit since the very beginning. If she judges you worthy, then so will I.

I have given her a task of the utmost importance. Go assist her.

==Progress==
Ah, it's you.

==Completion==
Listen up kid: I never wanted to set eyes nor foot upon the land of fancy pantsy Gilneans, not even to rob it. You want to earn my appreciation? Then help me complete this task from the boss so we can finish down here and leave this wretched place.
